Life Caught Up with Ryu Murakami――人生が小説に追いついた

小説を読んだ十代の自分に、数十年後の現実が追いつく。Ryu Murakami's words were not a handbook of perfect answers; they offered language for experiences we had yet to face. 十五の言葉を六つの軸で読み、pride and vulnerability、revenge and joy、personal responsibility and limitsの緊張を考える追悼エッセイ。
